outcome: Neonatal respiratory morbidity (respiratory distress syndrome and transient tachypnea of the newborn)
cohort: 4629 singleton infants born between 32 and 41 weeks gestation
finding: Premature rupture of membranes at 32-41 weeks gestation was not independently associated with an increased risk of neonatal respiratory morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with a significant risk for respiratory morbidity
